Record Class InstructorFeedbackReportService.Row

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.InstructorFeedbackReportService.Row
Enclosing class:
InstructorFeedbackReportService
public static record InstructorFeedbackReportService.Row(Long id, String quarter, String courseId, String section, String title, String email, String instructorName, boolean allocReasonable, boolean differentTACount, boolean differentULACount, boolean otherConcerns, Integer taAllocation, Integer ulaAllocation, Integer numTAsPreferred, Integer numULAsPreferred, String comments, LocalDateTime lastUpdated) extends Record
One feedback row as the admin's table shows it. The preferred counts are null unless their "different number" box is checked: an unchecked box keeps its number on file (issue #425), and that number is not meant. The allocations are null when the quarter has no recruitment of that type, or the course is not in it.
